about: Synthetic Cordwell Home & Hardware knowledge base. 40 passages across policy, services, product specs, and how-to content. Every passage is fictional. Distractors are written to share vocabulary with a gold query while answering a different question, which is what makes a reranker's job visible.

passages.title: Standard return window
passages.text: Most new, unused merchandise can be returned within 90 days of purchase with a receipt for a full refund to the original payment method. Cordwell Club members receive an extended 365-day window on most items.

passages.title: Returns without a receipt
passages.text: If you do not have a receipt, we can attempt to locate the purchase using the credit or debit card, phone number, or Cordwell Club account used at checkout. If the purchase cannot be located, returns are limited to store credit at the lowest advertised price within the last 90 days, a valid government-issued photo ID is required, and no-receipt returns are capped at three per customer per 180 days. Outdoor power equipment without a receipt is accepted only within 30 days.

passages.title: Outdoor power equipment returns
passages.text: Gas-powered pressure washers, mowers, chainsaws, and generators must be returned within 30 days of purchase. Units must be drained of fuel and oil before they are brought into the store. Items that have been fueled are subject to inspection and may be refused if damaged.

passages.title: Gasoline and fuel container returns
passages.text: Fuel containers, propane tanks, and any item that has contained gasoline cannot be returned once used, for safety reasons. Unused, sealed fuel containers follow the standard 90-day return window.

passages.title: Receipt lookup service
passages.text: Associates can reprint a receipt for any purchase made with a credit card, debit card, or Cordwell Club account within the last 24 months. Cash purchases cannot be looked up. Reprints are available at any register or the customer service desk.

passages.title: Paint return policy
passages.text: Custom-tinted paint cannot be returned or exchanged once mixed. Unopened, untinted paint and stain follow the standard 90-day window. If a tint does not match the sample chip, bring the can and the chip to the paint desk within 7 days and we will re-tint at no charge.

passages.title: Price match guarantee
passages.text: Cordwell will match the current advertised price of an identical in-stock item from a local competitor or a qualifying online retailer. Bring the ad or show the listing at checkout. Price matching excludes clearance, marketplace sellers, and Pro bulk pricing.

passages.title: Holiday return extension
passages.text: Purchases made between November 1 and December 24 may be returned through January 31 of the following year under the standard conditions. The extension does not apply to outdoor power equipment or major appliances, which keep their normal windows.

passages.title: Paint color matching
passages.text: The paint desk can match a color from any sample at least one inch square using a spectrophotometer. A standard match takes about 10 to 15 minutes while you wait. Fabric, glossy, and textured samples may take up to 30 minutes and are matched as a best effort. Matches to another brand's chip are also supported.

passages.title: Exterior paint dry and recoat times
passages.text: Cordwell Weatherguard exterior acrylic is dry to the touch in about 1 hour and can be recoated after 4 hours in conditions above 50 degrees F and below 85 percent humidity. Allow 24 hours before exposure to rain and 14 days for a full cure before washing the surface.

passages.title: Major appliance delivery and haul-away
passages.text: Free basic delivery is included on major appliances over 396 dollars within 50 miles of a store. Haul-away of one comparable old appliance is available for 30 dollars per unit and must be added at the time of purchase. The old unit must be disconnected and empty before the delivery team arrives. Delivery windows are 4 hours and are confirmed by text the evening before.

passages.title: Lumber and building materials delivery
passages.text: Bulk lumber, drywall, and roofing deliveries are scheduled through the Pro Desk and typically arrive within 2 business days. A flat 79 dollar fee applies within 30 miles. Curbside drop only; the crew does not carry materials inside or up stairs.

passages.title: Appliance installation services
passages.text: Professional installation is available for dishwashers, over-the-range microwaves, gas and electric ranges, and water heaters through licensed third-party installers. Pricing is quoted at checkout. Installation appointments are scheduled separately from delivery.

passages.title: Appliance protection plans
passages.text: Cordwell Care protection plans extend coverage for 3 or 5 years beyond the manufacturer warranty on major appliances and cover parts, labor, and food loss up to 300 dollars per incident. Plans must be purchased within 30 days of the appliance purchase.

passages.title: Key cutting
passages.text: Standard house and padlock keys are cut in about 5 minutes at the hardware desk for 2.49 dollars per key. Automotive transponder keys are programmed at the self-service kiosk in select stores, priced by vehicle.

passages.title: Restricted and do-not-duplicate keys
passages.text: Keys stamped Do Not Duplicate or Do Not Copy are honored as a courtesy restriction. Associates will not cut these keys without written authorization from the property owner or manager on letterhead. There is no additional fee beyond the standard per-key charge once authorization is verified. Patented high-security keys cannot be cut in store and are referred to the manufacturer.

passages.title: Lock rekeying service
passages.text: Bring in a compatible Kwikset or Schlage deadbolt or knob lock and the hardware desk will rekey it to a new key for 9.99 dollars per cylinder, including two new keys. Rekeying takes about 15 minutes. Smart locks and mortise locks are not supported.

passages.title: ProQuote bulk pricing
passages.text: ProQuote lets registered Pro customers submit a material list of 1,500 dollars or more and receive a volume quote within one business day. Quotes are valid for 7 days and lock pricing on in-stock items. Quotes can be reopened once for a 24-hour extension.

passages.title: Pro Business Account and payment terms
passages.text: The Cordwell Pro Business Account offers net-30 payment terms to approved businesses with an initial credit line based on application. Invoices are issued monthly and payable through the Pro portal. Net-30 terms apply to purchases made in store, online, and through ProQuote once the account is linked.

passages.title: Contractor volume discount
passages.text: Registered Pro customers earn a tiered discount at checkout: 2 percent on annual spend above 5,000 dollars, 5 percent above 25,000 dollars, and 8 percent above 100,000 dollars. The discount is applied automatically and cannot be combined with ProQuote volume quotes on the same transaction.

passages.title: Pro Desk hours and job-site pickup
passages.text: The Pro Desk opens at 5:30 AM Monday through Saturday. Orders placed online before 6 PM are staged for pickup at the Pro loading door the next morning. Curbside Pro pickup is available in all stores with a Pro Desk.

passages.title: Torrent 3100 PSI gas pressure washer
passages.text: The Cordwell Torrent T3100 gas pressure washer delivers 3100 PSI at 2.5 GPM with a 196 cc OHV engine and a 25-foot high-pressure hose. It ships with five quick-connect nozzles and a 1-gallon detergent tank. Weight is 68 pounds. Recommended for driveways, siding, and decks.

passages.title: Torrent 1900 PSI electric pressure washer
passages.text: The Cordwell Torrent E1900 electric pressure washer produces 1900 PSI at 1.3 GPM with a 13-amp motor and a 20-foot hose. It is best suited for patio furniture, vehicles, and small decks. Weight is 22 pounds. Includes a foam cannon and turbo nozzle.

passages.title: Pressure washer detergent guide
passages.text: Use only detergents labeled for pressure washers. Household bleach and dish soap damage pump seals. Apply detergent with the low-pressure soap nozzle, let it dwell for 5 minutes without drying, and rinse from the top down with the 25 or 40 degree nozzle.

passages.title: Volt 20V brushless drill and driver kit
passages.text: The Cordwell Volt 20V brushless drill and driver delivers 530 inch-pounds of maximum torque, a two-speed transmission at 0 to 450 and 0 to 1,800 RPM, and a 17-position clutch plus drill mode. The kit includes two 2.0 Ah batteries, a fast charger, and a belt clip.

passages.title: Impact driver versus drill
passages.text: An impact driver adds rotational hammering to drive long screws and lag bolts with less wrist strain and rarely strips heads. A drill and driver has a clutch for controlled depth and is the better choice for pilot holes, cabinetry, and drywall. Most Pros carry both.

passages.title: Driving drywall screws with a cordless drill
passages.text: Set the clutch low, around 4 to 6 on a 17-position clutch, and use the low-speed range. Drive until the screw head sits just below the paper surface without tearing it. If the clutch slips before the head dimples, step up one setting at a time. A dimpler bit stops the screw automatically and is worth the 5 dollars if you are hanging more than a few sheets.

passages.title: Installing drywall anchors
passages.text: For items under 20 pounds, self-drilling plastic anchors screw directly into drywall with no pilot hole. For 20 to 50 pounds, use a toggle bolt or snap toggle through a 1/2 inch hole. Anything heavier belongs on a stud. Do not overtighten; the anchor should be snug, not crushed.

passages.title: Preparing a deck for stain
passages.text: Sweep, then clean with a deck cleaner and a stiff brush or a pressure washer at 1500 PSI or less held 12 inches from the boards. Let the wood dry 48 hours. Sand raised grain with 80 grit, sweep again, and confirm the wood is ready by sprinkling water: if it soaks in within 10 seconds, the deck is ready to stain. Mask nearby siding and plants.

passages.title: Choosing a deck stain
passages.text: Transparent stains show the most grain and need recoating every 1 to 2 years. Semi-transparent stains last 2 to 3 years. Solid stains act like paint, hide imperfections, and last 3 to 5 years. Oil-based penetrates deeper; water-based cleans up easier and has lower odor.

passages.title: Deck board return and cut-to-length lumber
passages.text: Lumber and decking cut to a custom length in store cannot be returned. Uncut deck boards may be returned within 90 days if straight, dry, and free of fastener holes. Composite decking follows the same rule.

passages.title: Riding mower blade will not engage
passages.text: If the blade does not engage when you pull the PTO switch, check three things in order. First, confirm you are seated firmly, since the operator presence switch under the seat cuts blade power when weight is not detected. Second, check the PTO switch wiring connector under the dash for corrosion. Third, inspect the deck belt for a snapped or slipped belt. If all three pass, the electric PTO clutch itself may have failed and should be tested with a multimeter for about 2 to 3 ohms across the coil.

passages.title: Mower blade sharpening service
passages.text: Bring your mower blade to the hardware desk and we will sharpen and balance it for 8.99 dollars per blade, usually within 24 hours. Blades with chips deeper than 1/4 inch or visible cracks should be replaced, not sharpened.

passages.title: Ridgeline 42-inch riding mower
passages.text: The Cordwell Ridgeline R42 riding mower has a 42-inch two-blade deck, a 17.5 HP single-cylinder engine, hydrostatic transmission, and an electric PTO blade engagement switch. Cutting height adjusts from 1.5 to 4 inches in 7 positions. Fuel capacity is 1.5 gallons.

passages.title: Fixing a dripping faucet
passages.text: Turn off the supply valves under the sink and open the faucet to relieve pressure. Remove the handle, then the cartridge or ball assembly. Replace the worn O-rings or the cartridge with a matching kit, reassemble, and turn the water back on slowly. Most drips are a 15-minute fix with a 10 to 20 dollar kit.

passages.title: Programming a smart thermostat
passages.text: Most smart thermostats need a C wire for continuous power. If your existing wiring has no C wire, use the included power adapter kit or ask an electrician to run one. Label wires before removing the old unit, photograph the terminals, and follow the app pairing steps. Set a schedule with at least a 4-degree setback overnight.

passages.title: Special order and custom product returns
passages.text: Special order items, including custom blinds, custom cabinets, and configured storm doors, are subject to a 20 percent restocking fee if returned within 30 days and cannot be returned after that. Defective special orders are replaced at no charge.

passages.title: Online order returns in store
passages.text: Items purchased on cordwell.example can be returned to any store. Bring the order confirmation email or the packing slip; the barcode on either one is enough to process the return. Refunds to the original card post in 3 to 5 business days.

passages.title: Tool rental
passages.text: Cordwell Tool Rental offers pressure washers, tile saws, floor sanders, and trenchers by the 4-hour, daily, and weekly rate. A credit card deposit is required. Rentals returned late are charged an additional 4-hour block. Fuel-powered rentals must be returned with a full tank.

passages.title: Propane tank exchange
passages.text: Exchange an empty 20-pound propane tank for a filled one at the front entrance cage for 21.99 dollars. Tanks more than 12 years old or with a damaged valve are still accepted for exchange. Purchase of a new tank without exchange is 49.99 dollars.

gold_queries.query: Can I return a gas pressure washer if I lost the receipt?
gold_queries.why_hard: Distractors POL-003 and SPEC-001 share the phrase pressure washer, and POL-005 shares receipt. The gold passage never says pressure washer; it says outdoor power equipment.

gold_queries.query: How long does it take the paint desk to match a color from a fabric swatch?
gold_queries.why_hard: POL-006 and SVC-002 are about paint; POL-007 is about matching prices.

gold_queries.query: Will you take my old refrigerator away when the new one is delivered?
gold_queries.why_hard: Query says refrigerator and take away; gold says appliance and haul-away. SVC-005 and SVC-006 are appliance-adjacent distractors.

gold_queries.query: What clutch setting should I use to hang drywall with a cordless drill?
gold_queries.why_hard: SPEC-004 lists the clutch positions and torque; HOW-002 is about drywall; SPEC-005 mentions drywall and clutch.

gold_queries.query: Is there an extra charge to copy a key marked do not duplicate?
gold_queries.why_hard: SVC-007 has the per-key price; SVC-009 is key adjacent. Query says copy, gold says duplicate.

gold_queries.query: Can a contractor pay a ProQuote order on net-30 terms?
gold_queries.why_hard: PRO-001 is the ProQuote passage; PRO-003 is the contractor passage; the answer lives in the business account passage.

gold_queries.query: My riding mower blades will not turn on when I flip the switch, what do I check first?
gold_queries.why_hard: SPEC-006 mentions PTO blade engagement switch; HOW-007 is about blades.

gold_queries.query: What do I need to do to a deck before applying stain?
gold_queries.why_hard: HOW-004 and HOW-005 are deck and stain adjacent; SPEC-003 is about washing with a pressure washer.

gold_queries.query: Do I get more time to return a Christmas gift I bought in December?
gold_queries.why_hard: Query never says holiday or extension; POL-001 is the generic return window.

gold_queries.query: How much is the restocking fee on custom blinds?
gold_queries.why_hard: Several return passages compete; only one mentions a restocking fee.
